items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Yeah, and then Pat Cook on bass

ctx.x: Johnny Kuhlman was a singer, huh?
That's right. Yeah, and then Pat Cook on bass, and what's the name, Charlie, what's the drummer? Charlie Duke. Yeah, Charlie Duke, yeah.
And it looks like Rodas there. That's Joe Rodas there. Well, you didn't have darts that day.
